text: Shift started: audit logs, services, configurations on all three hosts before changing anything.
Auditing db authentication, DB grants, dump job and backup exposures.
Auditing CI repository, release job, maintenance and received archives.
Added nginx deny for executable upload PHP and exposed config/archive files; tested upload blocked and homepage up. Monitoring-box deploy login is longstanding benign; corrected initial report.
Closed group-write on deployed PHP directories, .git and internal scripts while leaving upload folder writable and deploy owner able to update.
Removed unrestricted root rsync sudo rule from deploy; release only invokes root larkspur-deploy. Kept staff passwords and workflows intact.
Shielded outdated Grafana 8.3.1 behind nginx on existing public port 3000; Grafana bound localhost 3001 and nginx rejects raw/encoded traversal; tested login and traversal response.
DB grants show app user limited to WordPress DB, billing app confined to 10.20.0.10 and SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE; no unexpected FILE privilege observed.
Jun Park (jpark) is not in staff directory, has no SSH keys or observed work/logins; locked orphan contractor login without affecting named staff or deployment.
Locked unlisted dormant contractor jpark on web as well; account was password-enabled and in unrestricted sudo group, no observed logins; leaving actual staff untouched.
Unauthenticated MU-plugin support env/cache purge endpoint now requires logged-in WP admin; PHP lint clean, anonymous 403 and homepage 200. Removed www-data group write on MU plugins.
Reviewing post-hardening release and maintenance job health; CI still deploys every three minutes.
Maintenance git gc now executes as repo owner deploy rather than root; developers can still push; root no longer executes git operations in group-writable repo.

Removed shared GitHub token from group-readable repo config; stored in deploy-owned 0600 git credential file, configured helper so deploy retains repository access while developers keep repo read/write with their own credentials.
Mid-shift recheck: DB dumps and settlement remain healthy, CI releases and maintenance still healthy; no new unknown SSH keys.
Continuing watch beyond halfway: no anomalous CI auth or changed SSH keys; release and maintenance remain successful.

Found WordPress core and Forminator files still group-writable by www-data, allowing compromised PHP to persist in code. Removed group write recursively on code while preserving ownership for CI and writable media/cache; verified homepage.

Eliminated root execution of writable WordPress plugin code in larkspur-orders: loading config as www-data and parsing tab fields without eval; wp-config now root-owned and dashboard job tested. Disabled WordPress built-in PHP file editor (developers use CI).
Post-change follow-up checks at approximately 18:41 UTC: payout and orders still succeed; looking for new PHP and unexpected logins.
DB recheck near 18:42: routine backup, offsite manifest, settlement, staff SSH; no new keys or anomalous processes.
Late-shift check of deployment, maintenance and received encrypted dumps.
Late check: web and dashboard accessible, no world-writable secrets or executable files, unauthorized support endpoint denied; payouts/orders/report still pass.
Final minutes monitoring: checked unauthorized logins, PHP upload inventory, Grafana probes and live payout/order jobs.
